pallass_door_alley.name: Pallass door alley

canon_ref.note: Where Hawk set the door's far end in Pallass (5.00, 5.01). A stone alley off a street; the sky there is bright and blue. The Pallass Watch under Venim holds it (5.02). Map pallass_door_street (M19.1).

pallass_door_alley.summary: A stone alley in Pallass where the Wandering Inn door opens. The Watch guards it.

pallass_streets.name: Pallass streets

canon_ref.note: Streets of Pallass: the military parade and the tour with Nelliam (5.01), and the street where Selys is snatched (5.17 S). Stone buildings.

pallass_streets.summary: The stone streets of Pallass. Parades, guides and trouble on the road to the door.

pallass_assembly_of_crafts.name: Assembly of Crafts

canon_ref.note: The ruling body of Pallass, which orders the door seizure and later the lease (5.01, 5.02). Its seat is not described; that it is a building is a guess.

pallass_assembly_of_crafts.summary: The governing hall of Pallass, where the Senators and Head Speakers meet.

grand_theatre.name: The Grand Theatre

canon_ref.note: Erin's [Grand Theatre] Skill (Level 34) makes the common room two to three times larger, with the Players' stage at one end (5.04). Used as a hall for plays, the moth dead and meetings (5.08, 5.12, 5.13).

grand_theatre.summary: Erin's common room grown huge, with a stage and room for a crowd.

inn_watchtower.name: Bird's watchtower

canon_ref.note: Bird's post atop the inn; stairs from the third floor lead up. The moths smash it to splinters (5.07, 5.08, 5.12). The inn's windows are broken too.

inn_watchtower.summary: The tower on top of the inn where Bird keeps watch. It is wrecked in the moth attack.

liscor_west_wall_door.name: Liscor's west wall door

canon_ref.note: After the moths, Erin's door opens in Liscor's western wall: a plain door that does not belong there (5.12). It is the way to the inn once the floodplains fill.

liscor_west_wall_door.summary: A plain door in Liscor's west wall that leads to Erin's inn.

canon_ref.note: A watched corner of Liscor with coffins, kept so the dead cannot rise. Zel's ashes are buried here at night (5.18 S). The coffin of General Sserys is here.

embria_camp.name: Embria's camp

canon_ref.note: The 4th Company's camp on a hill outside Liscor, cut off by the flood. They strike camp before dawn and wade to the city (5.13). Exact position not given.

embria_camp.summary: A Drake army camp on a hill in the flooded plains.

tyrion_war_camp.name: Tyrion's war camp

canon_ref.note: Lord Tyrion's war camp, set up weeks ago against the Goblin Lord (5.15). Yitton Byres comes there. Position not given.

tyrion_war_camp.summary: A rain-soaked war camp of House Veltras.

dwarfhalls_rest.name: Dwarfhalls Rest

canon_ref.note: Former Dwarf home turned Goblin bastion: the largest tribe in the north, ruled by the Great Goblin Chieftain Tremborag. It refused the Goblin Lord's summons (5.19 G).

dwarfhalls_rest.summary: A mountain fortress of old Dwarves, now the home of Tremborag's tribe.

salazsar.name: Salazsar

canon_ref.note: A Walled City whose Lord of the Wall reports the giant moths to the scrying council (5.08). Barely detailed.

salazsar.summary: A Drake Walled City on Izril. Off-map.

oteslia.name: Oteslia

canon_ref.note: A Walled City in the scrying council about the moths (5.08). Home of General Ironscales, who once held the Heartflame Breastplate (5.17 S).

oteslia.summary: A Drake Walled City on Izril. Off-map.

jerios_bazaar.name: Jerios Bazaar

canon_ref.note: A large market town that Flos visits to buy a sword (Interlude - Flos). Smiths and merchants sell steel of the Naq-Alrama clans.

jerios_bazaar.summary: A busy Chandrar bazaar of smiths. Off-map.

gec.name: Gec

canon_ref.note: A small, poor town in Laken's lands whose headman Filk thanks him for his guards (5.09 E). Off-map.

gec.summary: A small town near Riverfarm. Off-map.

liscor_city_hall.name: Liscor city hall

canon_ref.note: Rooms where Zel's casket is opened, the will is read and the Heartflame Breastplate is kept (5.16 S - 5.18 S). Not a map.

liscor_city_hall.summary: The rooms of Liscor's city government. Zel's body and his armour lie here.

canon_ref.note: Pisces sends a bone creature to clear the sewers (5.16 S, 5.17 S). Not a map.
Selys and Pisces read the Heartflame legends here (5.17 S). Not a map.
